name: Ebizuka Mihina
source: A cheeky elementary school girl. She's got far more knowledge of sexual matters than a typical girl her age. Became a new teacher judge so she can go to the school with the boy she likes. Has a sadistic streak and enjoys teasing older men, especially the lolicons. Gets joy from watching men get kicked out of the program because of her lewd behavior.
